text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 5xx rate detected on model-serving (us-west-2). Error spike started ~8282468085. Primary signatures: segfaults in model_runner, OOM eviction logs, gateway 502s. Alerting on-call. TL;DR: customers seeing increased timeouts and 5xx for generation endpoints. https://redwood.console/incidents/8282468100


dan: grabbing this. oncall now. can someone post the runbook slice for segfaults + kvcache?
alice: here: https://redwood.docs/runbooks/model-runtime-segfault. key steps: route traffic away, drain suspect nodes, collect core dump + dmesg, enable fallback variant.
dan: got it. running quick check: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep model-runner | wc -l` -> 48 pods. cpu/mem look normal from k8s, but kernel OOM logs present.
eva: past 3 mins: 12% 5xx on global gateway, us-west-2 ~22%. top customers affected: org-connex, tilewise (partial timeouts). I've DM'd account teams.
michael: pasted snippet from node with segfaults:
```
[ 12345.678901] model_runner[27456]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f9c2b1a3f20 sp 00007ffd2c1f6b80 error 4 in libattention.so[7f9c2a000000+1f0000]
[ 12345.679012] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 27456 (model_runner) total-vm:120000000kB, anon-rss:110000000kB
```

alice: good dump. looks like quantized kernel hitting OOM under certain batch shapes. check last deployment? any new kernel/quant patches?
dan: deployment history shows a minor quant patch rolled 2h ago to model-quant v1.3.2 -> v1.3.3 on a subset (canary). Canary rollout at 20% started 8262460000 (should be 2h ago). rolling back that canary now.
oncall-bot: @alice accepted the handoff. Oncall window 08:00-16:00 PT.
eva: starting traffic reroute to fallback model-variant (smaller kv/cache disabled) for affected routes: `/v1/generate` and `/v1/chat`. applying rate-limited failover for 30m.
michael: command I ran to tag and reroute: `redwood route update --from model-sherpa-13b-quant --to model-sherpa-13b-qv1 --weight 0.0 --scope us-west-2`
dan: initiating node drain for 6 pods that logged segfaults. `kubectl cordon` + `drain`. also bumping retry policy at gateway to 2 -> 4 for 5xx transient.
alice: collecting core dumps and machine dmesg. please upload to /internal/incidents/8282468100/ for postmortem. also enable verbose runtime tracing for the canary group.
eva: customer impact update: peak impact window 8282468085-8282468150 (~65s). error rate peaked 28% locally. approx 1300 requests failed in that window, predominantly generation calls > 512 tokens.
dan: mitigation progress: rollback of quant patch to v1.3.2 initiated -> will take ~90s to fully roll. fallback routing active. draining finished for 4 of 6 pods.
michael: got one reproducible stacktrace with batch_size=8, seq_len=2048 causing allocator spike. attaching small repro to ticket.
eva: post-rollback metrics: 5xx down from 22% -> 3% in us-west-2 within 45s of rollback and reroute. latency has some tail issues but errors are dropping.
oncall-bot: paging resolved: on-call retained. Incident state: mitigating. severity: SEV2.
dan: can we keep fallback for another 45m while we run full canary test? want to validate no regression.
alice: agree. will run a narrower canary with additional mem guards and kv cache throttling. also scheduling quick hotfix to change allocator limits if needed.
michael: note to postmortem: include model batch profile (8x2048), quant kernel version, allocator metrics from /metrics/runtime/alloc.
eva: notifying support + affected customers with status note: "we mitigated elevated 5xx by rolling back a quant canary and temporarily routing traffic to a fallback variant. investigating root cause; will follow up with postmortem."
dan: closing loop here: primary mitigations applied (rollback + reroute + node drains). monitoring for next 2 hours. if error >5% re-escalate. Thanks all :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: Incident updated: mitigations applied. Link: https://redwood.console/incidents/8282468100/updates/1
